game.title: Returnal
game.blurb: Roguelike sci-fi third-person shooter on a planet that changes with every death, from Housemarque (PC port with Climax Studios), released 2021-04-30. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Cycle: Story and Bosses

chapters.title: Biome Surveys

chapters.title: Xenoglyphs, Scout Logs and Archives

chapters.title: Combat and Builds
chapters.summary: Overloads, weapon proficiency, Integrity, Adrenaline, Parasites and Calculated Risk.

chapters.title: Simulation Mode Daily Challenges

chapters.title: Beyond the Main Achievements

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the PC release, Steam app 1649240 ("Returnal™"); RAWG lists PC and PlayStation 5, and lists "Returnal: Ascension" (2022-03-22) as a separate entry. The Steam schema calls the app "Rogue PC" (an internal name). No StrategyWiki page under "Returnal" or "RETURNAL". returnal.fandom.com answers the API under "Returnal", but the page links only 3 articles ("ASTRA", "Atropos", "Selene"), so it gave almost nothing; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 24 of 38 Steam achievements are hidden. Five hidden ones ("Ascending the Mountain", "Through the Forgotten City", "Echoes of the Past", "Frozen in Time", "Submerged in Memories") have low unlock rates (1.4 to 3.8%) close to the visible "Finish Overgrown Ruins Survey" (3.8%), so they were put in the surveys chapter; that is a guess. "Helios" asks for all main achievements, and seven hidden ones come after it in the list with rates from 2.3 to 28.7%; one visible description excludes "Tower of Sisyphus", so these seven may be extra content, but the data does not say so. The other 11 hidden ones sit in the story chapter.
